script_text: Aquarius, your Uranus-ruled Air nature flips from brainstorming to boundary-setting. Monday is sharp: Mercury in your 5th House sextiles Uranus in the 4th and trines Saturn in the 3rd, so a family idea becomes a creative plan. Tuesday into Wednesday, Mars squares Mercury, making texts, pitches, and errands feel combative; Wednesday is the worst for signing. Mid-week, the Sun in your 5th trines Pluto in your 1st, giving you confidence to claim a role. Late week, Venus in your 7th House trines Saturn, so a lover or client wants clarity, not games. By Sunday, Mars conjuncts Saturn in the 3rd; because Saturn rules your 10th House, invoices, contracts, and career emails may hit red tape. Monday is your power day because Mercury supports Uranus and Saturn. Sunday is the hardest day because Mars blocks Saturn. Keep one bold ask in writing. Follow for daily updates.
